newsitem.title: UK: Merrill hires BZW utilities corporate financier.
newsitem.headline: Merrill hires BZW utilities corporate financier.

text.p: U.S. investment banking giant Merrill Lynch & Co Inc confirmed on Thursday it had hired Martin Falkner from BZW, the investment banking arm of Britain's Barclays Plc, to join its UK investment banking team.
A Merrill Lynch spokesman said Falkner, 38, would be a senior member of its UK relationship management team focusing on the energy and utility sectors.
Falker had been head of the global utilities sector group in BZW's corporate finance division and before this spent six years working for BZW in New York on the oil and gas industry.
At Merrill Lynch in London, Falkner will report to Simon Mackenzie-Smith and Philip Yates, co-heads of the firm's UK investment banking team.
